_comments: NIGHTLY CHARGE RECONCILIATION (#477). SHIPS DISABLED AND IN PREVIEW: enabling it reports mismatches in
the run output and raises nothing until Preview is set to false. The gateway key needs read access to
charges and refunds. 05:00 UTC, after the other orders jobs. ConcurrencyMode Skip, MissedRunPolicy
RunOnce: the window is a week, so a catch-up is one run. OwnerUserID / NotifyUserID unset: they name

fields.Name: Orders — Reconcile Payment Provider Charges (daily)
fields.Description: Matches the payment gateway's charges and refunds of the last seven days to Orders' payments and reports the mismatches. Ships disabled and in preview; set Preview to false to raise mismatches as PROVIDER_CHARGE_MISMATCH finance exceptions.

_comments: WEBHOOK ENDPOINT DRIFT CHECK (#477), also run once at server start. Ships disabled like the other
orders jobs; it reads only, so enabling it is safe once a live provider exists. Hourly at :15.

fields.Name: Orders — Check Payment Webhook Endpoints (hourly)
fields.Description: Checks that each live payment provider's webhook endpoint at the gateway is enabled and sends every event kind Orders acts on. Drift fails the run. Ships disabled.
